assets.logo_placeholder: Use a simple typographic logo with a leaf or hoof icon in Primary color

instructions_to_main_agent: Install fonts by adding the Google Fonts links to `public/index.html` or importing in `index.css`.
Update `tailwind.config.js` with the provided color palette and border radius variables.
Use the 'Bento Grid' layout for the Dashboard: Total Stock (Big), Events (Tall), Locations (Square).
Ensure ALL forms have large touch targets (min 44px height) for ease of use in the field.
Implement the Login page with the `login_bg` image as a side panel or background overlay.
Use 'Outfit' font for all Headings (h1-h4) and 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for body text.
For the 'Daily Log', use a Step-by-Step wizard approach (Location -> Date -> Events) to avoid overwhelming the user.
Use distinct colors for species: Cattle (Green), Goat (Orange/Terracotta), Sheep (Blue/Sky) to make charts readable.
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for main backgrounds; use flat colors or subtle noise textures.
Avoid 'Inter' font; strictly use the specified fonts.
Ensure high contrast for outdoor visibility (WCAG AA compliant).
